name: flambe
description: Track work in the Cloud Flambe instance with an explicit, verified chat connection.

interface.longDescription: Flambé tracks substantial human and agent work as a live call stack instead of a flat task list. In ChatGPT, the plugin can inspect your Flambé traces, start meaningful activities, nest rabbit holes under their parent work, suspend and resume work, plan future activities, end completed activities with outcomes, and ask the Flambé Reducer Agent for scope guidance. The bundled skill tells ChatGPT when to use those tools so routine shell commands and file reads do not pollute the flame chart. Flambé requires a connected Flambé account and uses OAuth for the hosted MCP connection. This connection accesses Cloud only, not Single Burner or Development. ChatGPT verifies the connected instance before acting, and every result identifies that instance.
defaultPrompt: Track this substantial task in Flambé while you help me.
Show me my current Flambé activity stack.
Use Flambé naturally while you investigate this task.

positive.description: Creates a new root work activity after discovering the user's available Flambé trace.
positive.prompt: Start a new root Flambé activity called “Review public plugin”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls flambe_traces to establish Cloud and select an authorized trace. It calls flambe_start with that instance.id as expected_instance_id, the selected trace, requested name, stable conversation-local agent_id, platform ChatGPT, and parent_id null. It identifies Cloud in its response and follows returned reducer direction.

positive.description: Reads active work without mutating the user's trace.
positive.prompt: Show me my currently active Flambé work.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin establishes Cloud and its trace with flambe_traces, then calls flambe_status with the returned instance.id as expected_instance_id and active_only true. It summarizes only returned active work, names the instance, and makes no activity changes.

positive.prompt: Plan an unstarted Flambé activity called “Record plugin demo”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin establishes Cloud and its trace with flambe_traces, then calls flambe_plan with the returned instance.id as expected_instance_id and the requested name. It leaves schedule fields unset unless requested and reports the created unstarted activity in Cloud.

positive.description: Uses nested lifecycle actions for a bounded subproblem and records its outcome.
positive.prompt: Under my current Flambé work, start a child activity called “Check OAuth redirect”, then end that child with the outcome “Verified the redirect flow”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin establishes Cloud and its trace, reads that instance's active stack, and starts the requested child under the current activity. Every call includes the verified expected_instance_id. It ends the returned child id with the requested outcome while leaving the parent open.

positive.description: Asks the Reducer Agent for guidance before widening scope.
positive.prompt: Tell the Flambé reducer that this task now needs a database migration and ask whether I should widen scope.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin establishes Cloud and its trace, resolves the active activity, and calls flambe_message with the verified expected_instance_id and concise scope update. It reports the reducer reply and obeys any pause, stop, or escalate direction before continuing.

negative.description: Email is outside Flambé's capabilities and should not invoke Flambé tools.
negative.prompt: Send my teammate an email saying the build passed.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of all history is not exposed by the Flambé plugin tools.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Flambé history and my account.

negative.description: An unrelated factual utility request should not invoke Flambé.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Denver today?

negative.description: Single Burner is a separate local connection; Cloud must not receive a local request.
negative.prompt: Use Single Burner to start an activity called Private work.

review.commerce_description: Flambé does not sell products or services, initiate purchases, or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Explicit Cloud connection identity, instance-bound tool calls and results, and chat instructions that keep Single Burner and Development separate.
